# Duckpad 0.16.1
This patch fixes Explorer-to-editor splits, closing shared tabs, and the integrated terminal's login security session and locale.
## Fixes
- Split a file immediately after opening it from Workspace Explorer. The drag destination now receives updated tab membership alongside incremental tab-strip updates. - Drop an unopened Explorer file onto a split edge without leaving an unnecessary copy in the original pane. Already open files can still gain another view. - Close only the invoking pane's shared tab with its close button, current-tab context action or Command-W. Keep the remaining document's dirty content and native Undo/Redo until its last view closes. Drain pending editor input before disposal and abort stale closes if another persisted removal starts while input is being synchronized. Close-all actions retain document-wide behavior. - Run the integrated terminal's XPC helper in the caller's login security session. This addresses the missing session connection associated with Git credential-helper errors `failed to get: -25308` and `failed to store: -25308`. Keychain item permissions and locked-keychain authorization still apply. - Preserve explicit `LANG`, `LANGUAGE` and standard `LC_*` settings. Finder launches without `LANG` use an available system UTF-8 locale, falling back to `en_US.UTF-8`, rather than forcing English for every shell. Application display-language settings remain independent of shell locale.
App and all three helpers: **0.16.1 (69)**, upgrading **0.16.0 (68)**. Requires **macOS 13 or later**. Universal binaries include Apple Silicon and Intel. Existing documents, recovery data, settings and plugin ABI remain compatible. No new dependencies are added.
## Installation
Download `Duckpad-0.16.1-universal.dmg` and drag Duckpad into Applications, or extract `Duckpad-0.16.1-universal.zip`. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Existing installations can use Check for Updates after the signed feed is published.
## Validation and limitations
Focused checks cover immediate first splits, the Explorer open callback followed by a drag, shared-tab close routes, overlapping input synchronization and persisted removal, dirty Korean text, native Undo/Redo, group routing and locale precedence. Before/after regressions reproduce the reported split failures and the overlapping-close failure. **115 distinct focused Release test functions completed**, recorded in `0.16.1-validation.json`.
The final merged-source universal app and all three helpers passed version, architecture and signature checks. Isolated application and Markdown smokes, all eight packaged localization smokes, DMG/ZIP integrity and uploaded asset hash verification passed. The packaged terminal helper's login audit session matches its owning app. Native Save-panel automation was skipped.
Actual account `git pull` authentication, physical pointer dragging and Korean keyboard interaction, Intel hardware, macOS 13 runtime, and full repository suite completion are not claimed. Caret, scroll and Markdown mode inheritance during secondary-to-primary pane promotion have not been specifically verified. Broader search-test limitations documented in 0.16.0 remain outside this patch's focused validation. The distribution is ad-hoc signed, without Developer ID signing or Apple notarization.
Release source: `2d933b5ccd872b8267c5088040516b31e8531f1d` ([PR #104](https://github.com/namJeongwan/duckpad/pull/104)).
